proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The existence and characterizing property of the maximal open W with s|_{s^{-1}(W)} having P come from Descent, largest-open-of-the-base. In the groupoid diagram let W_1 be the maximal open of R over which pr_1 : R x_{s,U,t} R to R has P. Since P is tau-local on the target and {s} and {t} are tau-coverings, the same Descent lemma identifies t^{-1}(W), the locus where s has P after the covering t, with W_1, and likewise s^{-1}(W) = W_1; hence t^{-1}(W) = s^{-1}(W), which is R-invariance of W. (source lines 664-675)
